text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Now then! Let team training commence! Are we all fully prepared?!

text_block_list.name: All 3
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To properly assess everyone's stamina,
today we tackle the hill course!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hold up~! We're hittin' the slopes on unicycles! Found 'em
sittin' pretty in the equipment shed this mornin'!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Why unicycles all of a sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You blind to the vision? Why unicycles? ...'Cause it's
infinitely funnier, obviously! What else?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Just because of that?! Does this even build stamina?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Spicin' up the stakes, then! Whoever takes the fewest
water breaks takes the crown!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A friendly competition among us all? Count me in! Oh, we
should lay down boards on the path first. I'll go fetch them!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Such admirable initiative! Very well! Today
we shall contest each other on unicycles!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Loser buys yakisoba pan for the whole squad
on the way home!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Challenge accepted!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Um, I'm really sorry to make you take the second leg instead of me...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it... Can't be helped. Kendama and three-pointers
were on the task list, and you're terrible at both.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Top Road-kun's swimming is as majestic as a soaring dolphin show!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on... She looks like she's about to drown Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, here comes Top Road-san... Eeek?! She just
plowed straight into the bushes on her bike!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah-hahaha! A fateful rendezvous with a forest nymph?
How utterly poetic! Truly enviable!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. You never ride bikes anyway. Running's faster.
Can't blame you if you can't ride.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, haha... I've never been good with delicate tasks. That's
why I was so hesitant about entering a triathlon in the first place...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
But now that the running leg is mine, I'll fulfill
my duty without fail! Ayabe-san, thank you so much
for running with me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haah... haah...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (Ayabe-san is still behind me... If I launch my spurt from here... I can do this!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (Ayabe-san...! What incredible closing speed...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Gh... Haaaaah~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(I have to get faster or this won't be enough... But
if the distance were slightly longer at this pace...!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Keep the same distance next time? Personally,
I'd rather push it further.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ! You're right...! I want to extend the distance too!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —I'm calling it for today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah... I think I'll run just a little more!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Suit yourself. Don't trip in the dark. I'm heading back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for today! Great work out there!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Running alongside Ayabe-san made me realize... I still need
to study pacing and racing lines way more...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(My clumsiness ruined my swimming and biking,
so I have to make up for it on the run!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Alright! Time to double down on both study and solo drills!
